text:
emily: Heads-up: planning SDK pushes during tonight's publish window (18:00-20:00 PT). Py 1.5.0 and TS 2.0.0 targeted.
emily: Canary cadence: 5% -> 25% -> GA. TS includes async-only client; Python will deprecate legacy sync client with warnings.
sam: Ack. I'll run deploy-bot for canaries. Need exact package commands and dist-tags.
emily: Py: pip install redwood==1.5.0. TS: npm publish @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 then npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@2.0.0 next. Deprecation note: `redwood-sync` to be deprecated after Py GA.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled canary 1724503210-canary targets: py:1.5.0(5%), ts:2.0.0(5%). Start ETA +4m.
jia: Staging quick smoke failed on TS 2.0. Error: "TypeError: client.request is not a function" at lib/index.js:42. Looks like shim mismatch.
sam: Hold TS canary. Initiating rollback for TS canary only.
sam: deploy-bot, run: rollback 1724503210-canary-ts and revert dist-tag to 1.9.4
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollback in progress, removing 2.0.0 from 'next' and reassigning 1.9.4.
ops: For Python path, pin fallback on Dedicated: pinned redwood@1.4.12 to fallback pool (TTL 24h). Command: curl -X POST https://internal.ops/api/pins -d '{"package":"redwood","version":"1.4.12","pool":"fallback"}'
harry: I'll take release notes. Draft PR created; will mark TS delayed and note deprecation timeline.
emily: Rollback triggers: >2% error rate, production smoke/e2e failures, checksum/signature mismatch, or auth regressions >1%.
ops: Alerts: token-level error rate and latency thresholds set (2% errors or +30ms p50). Playbook to unpin/reassign tags uploaded.
sam: Proceeding with Py canary at 5% now, monitor 30m. TS GA postponed until shim fix lands.
emily: Action owners: sam (deploy), jia (TS fix), harry (notes), ops (pins/alerts). Ping #eng-oncall if rollback triggers fire.
emily: proceeding with Py canary :rocket:
